output.poi_name: William V. Banks Broadcast Museum & Media Center

gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.048825 42.331408)',4326)::geography, 3000)
  AND p.tourism = 'museum'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

```sql
WITH coney_island AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-83.048825, 42.331408), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
museum_search_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(coney_island.geom, 3000) AS buffer_geom
  FROM coney_island
),
museum_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    poi.poi_name,
    poi.geometry
  FROM pois poi
  JOIN museum_search_area
    ON ST_DWithin(poi.geometry::geometry, museum_search_area.buffer_geom::geometry, 0)
  WHERE poi.tourism = 'museum'
),
elevation_check AS (
  SELECT
    mc.poi_name,
    mc.geometry,
    (ST_Value(public.dem_us.rast, mc.geometry::geometry, true)) AS elevation
  FROM museum_candidates mc
  JOIN public.dem_us
    ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, mc.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT
  poi_name
FROM elevation_check
WHERE elevation >= 40;
```
